decision.rationale: The feature is not another orchard or felled-tree loot. The required second tree-preserving action is incompatible with native shared PlantCollected/fruit-primary and on-destruction frameworks. Vivi demonstrates technical feasibility but requires unrelated race/DLC/Harmony and no source reuse permission. Minimal independent AMJ-original per-tree Job/save path preserves Environment timber and optional MO and adds no artificial gather bench. The decision authorizes only mechanism code and its static checks; exact gameplay output and runtime release require separate accepted specifications and tests.
decision.independent_gap: No directly comparable viable lightweight independently targetable, persistent living-tree collection on existing wood-primary AMJE Shii without changing original timber harvest or introducing unrelated mandatory content.
